upstream_note: lxfontes/ezxml is a GitHub mirror of Lucas Fontes' ezXML 0.8.6; HEAD (dcb1748) is the last commit (2011-12-29) and is unpatched, so the 2021 CVEs reported against ezXML 0.8.6 apply directly to this tree.
binary_build_target: make test  (defines EZXML_TEST, links ezxml.o into the `ezxml` test driver)
entrypoint: main() in ezxml.c under #ifdef EZXML_TEST (line 1000); parses an XML file given as argv[1]
trigger_input: crafted XML file passed as the first CLI argument
vuln_class_scope: out-of-bounds (Veritas is instantiated for OOB only)

validation.binary_artifact_recipe: Dockerfile + build.sh (-O0, stripped and unstripped, plus ASan variant)
validation.poc_source: public (SourceForge ezxml bug tracker #26, #27; Debian LTS DLA batch)
validation.validated_by: patch/CVE cross-reference (function names located at the exact commit; lines cited below)
